liz (eng-sre): heads up — Thu 06:00-08:00 UTC we're running a graceful-degradation routing rehearsal + model-fallback sim. Purpose: validate the new 'graceful-deg' routing policy and automated fallback to quantized_64. expect small p95 blips, no customer-visible errors planned. runbook: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/graceful-deg-rehearsal
sam (oncall): i'm primary for the window. what's the rollback trigger?
liz (eng-sre): rollback if sustained p95 > 2x baseline for 10m OR error-rate > 0.5% for 5m after shift. also monitor smoke prompts.
maya (platform): will this hit dedicated pools with pinned models?
liz (eng-sre): hosted only for this sim. dedicated excluded.
ryan (sre-lead): quick checks: KV cache warmup, batching unchanged, routing logs, cost delta.
ops-bot: maintenance scheduled: Thu 2026-03-26 06:00-08:00 UTC. reminders 24h & 1h before.
sam (oncall): traffic shift plan?
liz (eng-sre): ramp: 0 → 1% → 5% → 25% → 50% → 100% over ~30m. each step 5-10m. abort on rollback triggers.
maya (platform): log filter for routing traces: FILTER: routing_policy=graceful-deg AND route in (chat,generate) AND model_variant!=primary
use to grep request.log.
ryan (sre-lead): dashboard: p50/p95, error-rate, smoke-fail-count, model_variant_distribution. alert at error-rate > 0.5% to page.
sam (oncall): i'll mute noisy alerts except paging.
liz (eng-sre): exec runbook excerpt: purpose, scope (hosted only), expected impact (transient p95 +~200ms), rollback details.
Command example to shift traffic:
curl -X POST https://infra-api/routing/shifts -d '{"policy":"graceful-deg","route":"chat","percent":5}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOKEN"
maya (platform): pushed 50-smoke prompts to monitoring job. will report mismatches.
ryan (sre-lead): contingency: if correctness regressions >1% or user reports, rollback + open P1.
sam (oncall): do we need customer comms?
liz (eng-sre): no, low blast radius. weekly infra digest note only.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled for Thu 03:00 UTC.
maya (platform): post-run: compare cost delta & latency per-token, update Optimize recommendations if quantized viable.
ryan (sre-lead): please ack if on bridge during window.
sam (oncall): ack — i'll be on bridge.
liz (eng-sre): ack — i'll lead and own rollback. will post bridge link 30m prior. :thumbsup:
